correctness.rationale: Acyclic orientations are bijective to ordered nonempty source layers of monochromatic parts with adjacent layer colors unequal. Deleting C-layers gives exactly 14 labelled A/B skeletons; mandatory equal-color gaps and optional other gaps yield exact exponential generating sum. Expanding all 14 produces five explicit polynomial bases L0...L4 and coefficients of the claimed exponential generating function, proving all n>=1. Independent symbolic 14-skeleton aggregation and direct orientation cycle checks for n=1,2,3 match every coefficient; t=1 and -1 and palindromicity also agree. Finite checks corroborate a symbolic all-n proof.
